summary: The sheet provides enlarged toilet room plans, accessory elevations and schedules, signage details, and a lavatory section. One internal coordination discrepancy was observed in the signage mounting criteria between Detail 4 and its signage notes.

drafts.title: Conflicting signage mounting-height criteria
drafts.observation: Detail 4 presents two different mounting criteria for the same tactile signage: the elevation indicates “48" MIN. AFF. B. OF BRAILLE” and “60" MAX. AFF. T. OF TACTILE,” while Signage Note 2 states that the sign mounting height is to be “60" ABOVE THE FINISHED FLOOR TO THE CENTERLINE OF THE SIGN.” These criteria do not describe the same sign location and may produce incompatible mounting heights.
drafts.drawing_evidence: Detail 4, TYP. SIGNAGE HEIGHT ELEVATION, shows “48" MIN. AFF. B. OF BRAILLE” and “60" MAX. AFF. T. OF TACTILE.” The adjacent Signage Notes state: “SIGN MOUNTING HEIGHT SHALL BE 60" ABOVE THE FINISHED FLOOR TO THE CENTERLINE OF THE SIGN.”
drafts.drawing_location: Detail 4 at the upper-right portion of the sheet: signage elevation and Signage Notes below/right of the elevation.
drafts.recommendation: Reconcile the Signage Note 2 centerline requirement with the dimensional limits shown in Detail 4, and identify one governing mounting-height criterion for the restroom and exit signage shown on this sheet. Confirm the final criterion against the applicable accessibility design basis before permit issuance.

published.title: Keynote citation needs confirmation

published.drawing_location: Detail 4 at the upper-right portion of the sheet: signage elevation and Signage Notes below/right of the elevation.
published.recommendation: Confirm the keyed-note number against the sheet before treating the specification as missing or deficient.
